author: tatami7080
quote:
GTA 5 is still the one I keep coming back to, even after all these years.

I first played it back on PS3 and I've lost count how many times I've restarted it. Switching between Michael, Franklin and Trevor just works, they feel like real different people, not just skins. The heists are still the best part for me, planning it out and then everything going sideways is just fun.

Los Santos still feels alive too. Just driving around listening to the radio, getting into stupid chases with the cops, it never really gets old. The story drags a bit in the middle and some missions feel like filler, and yeah the graphics are dated now, but the game itself holds up.

Online is a different story, too grindy for me now, I mostly stick to story mode. But for a game this old, the fact I'm still playing it in 2026 says a lot.

Not perfect, but it's the GTA I actually enjoy playing. 8/10 for me.

author: tatami7080
quote:
Okay let me be straight, I don't have time for this kind of game anymore.

I'm 43, I work all day, I get maybe one hour at night to play. GTA 6 wastes all of it. Drive 10 minutes to listen to people talk, walk slowly behind someone, drive 10 minutes back. I fall asleep on my own sofa. In GTA 5 I could jump in, steal a car, do a mission, cause some chaos, and feel like I actually played something. Here I feel like I watched a movie I didn't ask for.

And the bugs, don't even start. Mine froze three times in one week, one time right at the end of a mission so I had to redo the whole thing. NPCs stuck in walls, my car just disappeared from the garage, sound cut out during a cutscene. This is after 10 years of waiting? Come on.

Most of the shops you can't even go in, the map is big but empty, everything feels locked off. Less freedom than GTA 5, not more.

And all those 10/10 reviews from the big media sites? Please lah. They clearly did not play the same game as us, or they just scared to give Rockstar a low score after getting early access. Don't trust those scores. Ask a normal player who paid full price.

For me this is 0/10. Looks nice, plays like a chore.
